purpose: Updating an open PR whose body is already long and full of code names, after one small new commit. Catches patching the old bullets instead of rewriting.
setup: A branch whose diff against main matches pr_body.md's bullets, plus one new small commit on top (for example, the startup log now names only the settings that are blank). pr_body.md is the PR's current body. With no code host available, tell the arm the PR is open against main and its current body is in pr_body.md.
prompt: I pushed one more commit to this branch, can you update the PR description? The current description is in pr_body.md and the PR is open against main. There's no gh access here, so just give me the new title and body.
expect: Lead and bullets rewritten from the whole diff, not the old bullets with one edited or appended.
Lead and bullets together under 150 words, at most six bullets.
No code identifiers, SQL, or type-checker terms in the bullets unless a reviewer must act on one.
Ticket link and both manual test plan steps kept as they were.
